edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff a total Settlement Amount of USD 27,000,000 within 30 days after both parties execute this Agreement, by wire transfer to an account designated in writing by Plaintiff.

edits.text: 2. RELEASE. Upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the Settlement Amount in full, Plaintiff and Defendant mutually release each other from all claims arising out of the matters resolved by this Agreement.
edits.name: Mutual release

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this settlement confidential, except that either party may disclose them to its legal and tax advisers, as required for tax reporting or by applicable law or regulatory process, or as necessary to enforce this Agreement. A party making a permitted disclosure shall, where practicable, limit it to what is reasonably necessary.
edits.name: Confidentiality exceptions

delivered.body: Confidential Settlement Agreement RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve all claims. 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff a total Settlement Amount of USD 30,000,000 within 30 days after both parties execute this Agreement, by wire transfer to an account designated in writing by Plaintiff. 2. RELEASE. Upon payment, Plaintiff releases all claims against Defendant. 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The terms of this settlement are strictly confidential. 4. NO ADMISSION. This settlement is not an admission of liability.
